title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Flow Control Verification
scope: This verification covers aggregate connection receive limits, per-stream receive limits, stream-creation limits, runtime handshake commit enforcement, transport-parameter round-tripping, and 0-RTT remembered flow-control limits. It does not add a custom DoQ flow-control layer.
preconditions: The test assembly can access the shared QUIC transport internals used by the existing requirement-home suite.
expected_result: The focused flow-control contract tests pass, transport parameters round-trip the flow-control values, the runtime commit path applies those limits into bookkeeping, 0-RTT remembered limits are preserved, and the SpecTrace artifacts validate cleanly.
status_summary: The shared QUIC transport runtime owns DoQ flow control. Contract tests prove connection, stream, stream-creation, handshake commit, and 0-RTT behavior without introducing a custom DoQ flow-control layer.
